candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The seven provided input quantities span four independent SI dimensions (mass M, length L, time T, temperature Θ). By Buckingham Pi, 7 variables minus 4 independent dimensions yields 3 independent dimensionless groups. Natural choices are the Nusselt number Nu, the Rayleigh number Ra = g·α·ΔT·h^3/(ν·κ), and the Prandtl number Pr = ν/κ, so Nu = F(Ra,Pr). The following lists each input with a plain-language definition and its SI base exponents.
